name: tggifts-open-data
title: TG Gifts Index and Telegram gift floor prices (open data)
description: Daily Telegram gift floor prices from public Fragment pages and the TG Gifts Index (TGGI). Fragment only; gaps are not interpolated. Not financial advice.

fields.name: date
fields.description: UTC day the index value is frozen for

fields.name: value
fields.description: TG Gifts Index (TGGI) in index points, base 100 on 2026-10-18; GRAM-denominated floors, chain-linked, liquidity-weighted

fields.name: change_pct
fields.description: percent change vs the previous published day; empty on the base day

fields.name: constituents
fields.description: number of gift collections included in that day's index

resources.name: tggi-index-json
resources.description: TG Gifts Index: latest value, history, constituents, weights, method version, corrections

resources.name: floors-daily
resources.description: One floor point per collection per day

fields.name: floor_gram
fields.description: cheapest Fragment buy-now listing in GRAM (formerly TON), first value seen that UTC day; empty if the scan failed (never interpolated)

fields.name: recent_sales
fields.description: number of recent sales visible on the Fragment collection page that day (a liquidity hint)

resources.name: models-daily
resources.description: Per-model floors, one file per UTC day

fields.name: rarity_permille
fields.description: model rarity in per mille as shown by Fragment

fields.name: floor_gram
fields.description: cheapest buy-now listing of that model in GRAM

fields.name: buy_now_listings
fields.description: number of buy-now listings of that model that day

fields.name: open_date
fields.description: first day with data in the week

fields.name: close_date
fields.description: last day with data in the week

fields.name: days_with_data
fields.description: days with a floor value in the week

resources.name: track-record
resources.description: Snapshot of the public track record: below-floor alerts and what happened to them (sold / still_listed / unknown); estimated_profit_after_5pct_fee is an estimate at alert time, not realised profit
